title: Facial emotion recognition of sadness relates to superior parietal gray matter volume in mild cognitive impairment
summary:
Abstract
                  Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is associated with early, regionally selective neurodegenerative changes that may affect socioemotional functioning before atrophy becomes widespread. This study examined whether structural brain alterations in MCI relate to facial emotion recognition performance. Sixty adults (30 MCI, 30 healthy controls), aged 50–86 years, completed neuropsychological testing, the Facial emotion composite Task, and structural MRI. Whole-brain voxel-based morphometry revealed no significant gray matter volume differences between groups. However, targeted region-of-interest ROI analyses demonstrated lower right amygdala and bilateral hippocampal volumes in patients with MCI. Cortical thickness analyses identified two regions with lower thickness in MCI: the right superior parietal lobule and the left posterior insula. A significant Group × Sadness interaction indicated that the association between left superior parietal gray matter volume and sadness recognition differed between groups. Follow-up analyses of the extracted values showed a positive association in MCI, although this within-group association did not reach statistical significance, and a significant inverse association in HCs. These findings suggest that early MCI involves selective thinning in association cortices supporting attention and salience processing. The sadness-specific interaction indicates that patients with MCI may rely on preserved superior parietal structure during sadness recognition, a pattern that is consistent with structural reserve accounts, although this interpretation remains speculative given the cross-sectional design.

标题：轻度认知障碍中面部悲伤情绪识别与上顶叶灰质体积的关系
摘要：轻度认知障碍（MCI）与早期、区域选择性的神经退行性改变相关，这些改变可能在萎缩广泛化之前即影响社会情绪功能。本研究考察MCI中的结构性脑改变是否与面部情绪识别表现相关。60名成年人（30名MCI患者，30名健康对照），年龄50–86岁，完成神经心理学测试、面部情绪复合任务及结构性MRI。全脑基于体素的形态学分析未发现组间显著灰质体积差异。然而，针对性感兴趣区（ROI）分析显示，MCI患者右侧杏仁核及双侧海马体积较低。皮层厚度分析识别出MCI中两个厚度较低的区域：右侧上顶叶小叶和左侧后岛叶。显著的组别×悲伤交互作用表明，左侧上顶叶灰质体积与悲伤识别之间的关联在两组间存在差异。对提取值的后续分析显示，MCI中呈正相关（尽管该组内关联未达统计显著性），而健康对照中呈显著负相关。这些发现提示，早期MCI涉及支持注意和显著性加工的联合皮层选择性变薄。悲伤特异性交互作用表明，MCI患者在悲伤识别过程中可能依赖保留的上顶叶结构，这一模式与结构储备假说一致，但鉴于横断面设计，该解释仍属推测性。
关键词：轻度认知障碍；面部情绪识别；上顶叶；灰质体积；社会认知

title: Sensory encoding of emotion conveyed by the face and visual context
summary:
Abstract
                  Humans rapidly detect and interpret sensory signals that have emotional meaning. The posterior superior temporal sulcus (pSTS) and amygdala are known to be critical for this ability, but their precise contributions remain contentious. Here we investigate how these structures process visual emotional cues using artificial neural networks (ANNs) to model fMRI signal acquired as human participants view complex, naturalistic stimuli. Characterizing data from two archival studies (Ns = 20, 45), we evaluated whether representations from ANNs optimized to recognize emotion from facial expressions alone or the broader visual scene differ in their ability to predict brain responses. We found that abstract representations of facial expressions were more strongly encoded in pSTS than the amygdala, whereas representations of the broader emotional scene were robustly encoded in both regions. These findings demonstrate how the pSTS operates on abstract representations of facial expressions to a greater extent than the amygdala, which more strongly encodes the broader emotional significance of visual information, depending on the context.

标题：面部与视觉情境所传达情绪的感觉编码
摘要：人类能够快速检测并解读具有情绪含义的感觉信号。后颞上沟（pSTS）与杏仁核已知在该能力中至关重要，但其确切贡献仍存在争议。本研究利用人工神经网络（ANN）对参与者观看复杂自然刺激时获取的fMRI信号进行建模，考察这些结构如何处理视觉情绪线索。基于两项档案研究的数据（样本量分别为20和45），我们评估了仅针对面部表情或更广泛视觉场景进行情绪识别优化的人工神经网络表征在预测大脑反应方面的差异。结果发现，面部表情的抽象表征在pSTS中的编码强于杏仁核，而更广泛情绪场景的表征在两个区域均得到稳健编码。这些发现表明，pSTS比杏仁核更大程度地加工面部表情的抽象表征，而杏仁核则更强地编码视觉信息更广泛的情绪意义，且这种编码取决于情境。
关键词：情绪编码；后颞上沟；杏仁核；面部表情；人工神经网络

title: Why Do People Regulate Their Emotions? A Taxonomy of Motives in Emotion Regulation
summary: Emotion regulation involves the pursuit of desired emotional states (i.e., emotion goals) in the service of superordinate motives. The nature and consequences of emotion regulation, therefore, are likely to depend on the motives it is intended to serve. Nonetheless, limited attention has been devoted to studying what motivates emotion regulation. By mapping the potential benefits of emotion to key human motives, this review identifies key classes of motives in emotion regulation. The proposed taxonomy distinguishes between hedonic motives that target the immediate phenomenology of emotions, and instrumental motives that target other potential benefits of emotions. Instrumental motives include behavioral, epistemic, social, and eudaimonic motives. The proposed taxonomy offers important implications for understanding the mechanism of emotion regulation, variation across individuals and contexts, and psychological function and dysfunction, and points to novel research directions.

标题：人们为何调节情绪？情绪调节动机的分类学
摘要：情绪调节涉及为实现更高阶动机而追求期望的情绪状态（即情绪目标）。因此，情绪调节的性质与后果可能取决于其所服务的动机。然而，旨在研究情绪调节动机的研究一直未受到足够关注。通过将情绪的潜在益处映射到关键人类动机，本综述识别出情绪调节中的关键动机类别。所提出的分类学区分了针对情绪即时现象学的享乐动机与针对情绪其他潜在益处的工具性动机。工具性动机包括行为性、认知性、社会性和幸福论动机。该分类学为理解情绪调节的机制、个体与情境间的差异以及心理功能与功能障碍提供了重要启示，并指出了新的研究方向。
关键词：情绪调节；动机；享乐动机；工具性动机；分类学

title: A Case Study in Neuromarketing: Analysis of the Influence of Music on Advertising Effectivenes through Eye-Tracking, Facial Emotion and GSR
summary: Music plays an important role in advertising. It exerts strong influence on the cognitive processes of attention and on the emotional processes of evaluation and, subsequently, in the attributes of the product. The goal of this work was to investigate these mechanisms using eye-tracking, facial expression and galvanic skin response (GSR).Nineteen university women were exposed to the same TV ad of a perfume in our Laboratory (https://neurolabcenter.com/). Nine of them were randomly assigned to the music version and ten to the silent version. During viewing, the visual areas of interest, the fixation time, the facial emotions and the GSR were recorded. Before and after viewing the subjects completed a questionnaire. Results: 1) The commercial with music caused a GSR level higher than without music. The GSR evaluates the degree of arousal (emotion)., 2) The facial expression indicated that the variable "enjoy" and "engagement" were significantly higher in the version with music. The positive valence (liking) presented higher values in the musical version, 3) However, the evaluation of the variable "attention", measured through facial expression, did not show differences between the groups. There were also no differences in the heat maps of areas of interest. 4) The attributes evaluation of the product, measured with the pre-post questionnaire, showed greater increases after exposure to the musical version, but only in specific product’s attributes, such as "power" but not on other attributes, such as "status". These results are interpreted within the framework of the recent theories of advertising and music (Oakes, 2007).

标题：神经营销案例研究：通过眼动追踪、面部情绪和皮肤电反应分析音乐对广告效果的影响
摘要：音乐在广告中发挥着重要作用。它对注意力的认知过程以及评价的情绪过程产生强烈影响，并进而影响产品属性。本研究旨在利用眼动追踪、面部表情和皮肤电反应（GSR）来探究这些机制。十九名女大学生在实验室（https://neurolabcenter.com/）中观看了同一则香水电视广告。其中九人被随机分配到有音乐版本，十人被分配到无音乐版本。观看过程中，记录了视觉兴趣区域、注视时间、面部情绪和GSR。观看前后，受试者完成了问卷。结果：1）有音乐的广告引起的GSR水平高于无音乐版本。GSR评估唤醒（情绪）程度。2）面部表情表明，变量“享受”和“参与度”在有音乐版本中显著更高。正效价（喜爱）在有音乐版本中呈现更高值。3）然而，通过面部表情测量的变量“注意力”的评估未显示组间差异。兴趣区域的热图也无差异。4）通过前后问卷测量的产品属性评估显示，接触有音乐版本后，特定产品属性（如“力量”）有更大提升，但其他属性（如“地位”）则无。这些结果在近期广告与音乐理论（Oakes，2007）的框架内进行了解释。
关键词：神经营销；音乐；广告效果；面部情绪；皮肤电反应
